story: Prairie Creek Redwoods State Park is a coastal sanctuary in California for old-growth Coast Redwood trees. Created in 1923, the 57-square-kilometre park is home to Roosevelt elk, the tailed frog, and several species of salmon.
matters: The park is jointly managed as part of the Redwood National and State Parks, which has been collectively designated as a World Heritage Site and forms a part of the California Coast Ranges International Biosphere Reserve.
name: Prairie Creek Redwoods State Park
